_readme: GAME CONTENT, DRAFT PENDING PRODUCER REVIEW (every name and line). The NPC dialogue layer (docs/design/area-zero.md; the model is the Grove design's DialogueLineData { NpcId, Conditions, Text, Priority }, so the Grove's condition-resolved lines join this file later): Npcs (NpcId, DisplayName, PortraitKey = an art-manifest key, '' = a placeholder portrait), Lines (LineId, NpcId, Conditions, Text, Priority; a scene's own lines carry scene:{SceneId}, so the Grove's resolution never picks them) and Scenes (SceneId, Title, LineIds: an ordered run of lines a story location plays, regions.json FixedNodes SceneId). v1 cast: the Grove Keeper, Hearthglen's mentor, who later tends the Grove hub. Validated by BeastCraft.Tutorial.DialogueValidator (content load and the EditMode tests). Tone: content-bible.md (warm, wonder first; nobody dies).

Lines.Text: There you are. I am the Grove Keeper; I have tended this shrine since before the old oak by the mill was an acorn.
Your beast chose you. That is how every Beastbinder begins: not with a leash, but with a promise.
Hold out your hand. There: a small mending light, your first binder art. You will never strike in a fight; you will keep your friends standing.
Take these Fury Draughts, for when a fight turns against you. And go gently: the hedgerows are restless, and the Gloam's shimmer has reached the far hedge.
Rest here a while. The lanterns keep the haze at bay.
The miller says the Seals are only an old story. They are not. One sleeps in Verdant Hollow, just past the ridge.
Your newest friends are keen to keep up. Sit with them a while, and they will stand as tall as your first.
You calmed it. See how the haze slipped off, and the creature wandered home, dazed but whole? That is your work now.
Verdant Hollow starts past this ridge, and the Gloam is thicker there. Some places lie off the path: explore, and the map will fill in.
When you need a quiet place, find me at the Grove. And listen for kinship stones in the wild: more beasts are waiting to meet you.
The wild remembers kindness. So do I.
